description: This file contains functions for managing stock reordering in ERPNext, including creating material requests when stock levels reach reorder points, and sending notifications about reorder actions and errors.

methods.name: reorder_item
methods.description: Main function to trigger reorder process if stock reaches reorder level.

methods.name: _reorder_item
methods.description: Performs the core logic of checking stock levels and creating material requests.

methods.name: get_item_warehouse_projected_qty
methods.description: Calculates projected quantities of items across warehouses and their parent warehouses.

methods.name: create_material_request
methods.description: Creates material request documents based on reorder levels and quantities.

methods.name: send_email_notification
methods.description: Sends email notifications about generated material requests.

methods.name: notify_errors
methods.description: Sends notifications about errors encountered during reorder processing.
